_comment: Suro's decisions on individual documents. The selection reads this file and obeys it:
a refused document is never chosen again, whatever its score, and an approved one is
recorded so the set can be reproduced. Reasons are kept because a later phase will be
asked why a document was or was not used.
The 15 MiB fetch cap is a rule, not a preference: a document above it is not eligible at
all in Phase 0, so no selection may carry one as an exception.

refused.reason: 21.3 MB, above the 15 MiB Phase 0 fetch cap. Size exception refused: the pilot proves the pipeline inside its stated limits.
16.0 MB, above the 15 MiB Phase 0 fetch cap. Size exception refused, same reason.
